dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

This record covers single maps of counties of California, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps, multi-sheet single maps and may also include some plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps may also show various subjects, such as roads, topography, geology, hydrology, and recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
